fusions.name: Plague Carrier
fusions.desc: A jabbing bite that deals 12 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 6 seconds and has a 40% chance to leave it [Diseased] for 8 seconds. Your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Sip and Slip
fusions.desc: A quick prick that deals 4 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and heals you for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Hop and Aim
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 10 seconds, and you hop 2 tiles when you use it.

fusions.name: Sudden Elsewhere
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, you deal 30% more physical damage for 2 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
